sloka: वृद्धाया धर्मशीलाया मातुर्नार्हस्यवर्त्तितुम् ।अस्यास्तु वचनं कुर्वन् नातिवर्त्ते: सताङ्गतिम् ॥ २.१११.६॥
transliteration: vṛddhāyā dharmaśīlāyā māturnārhasyavarttitum ।asyāstu vacanaṁ kurvan nātivartte: satāṅgatim ॥ 2.111.6॥

translations.english: Here is your aged and righteous mother. It does not behove you to deny your service to her. By obeying her, you will never deviate from the path of the virtuous.
